zh: 我下个月想请一周年假。
en: I'd like to take a week of {annual leave} next month.

zh: 我的绩效考核定在下周四。
en: My {performance review|performance appraisal} is next Thursday.

zh: 会后我会把待办事项发给大家。
en: I'll send out the {action items|action points} after the meeting.

zh: 她明天有个工作面试。
en: She has a {job interview} tomorrow.

zh: 我们每周一早上开团队会议。
en: We have a {team meeting} every Monday morning.

zh: 我午休的时候去一趟银行。
en: I'll pop to the bank during my {lunch break|lunch hour}.

zh: 这不在我的岗位职责说明里。
en: That's not in my {job description}.

zh: 我的离职通知期是四周。
en: I have a four-week {notice period}.

zh: 下周一是公共假日，办公室不开门。
en: Next Monday is a {public holiday|bank holiday}, so the office is closed.

zh: 请在工作时间内联系我们。
en: Please contact us during {business hours|office hours|working hours}.

zh: 她今年得到了百分之五的加薪。
en: She got a five percent {pay rise|pay raise|salary increase|raise} this year.

zh: 他下周去惠灵顿出差。
en: He's going on a {business trip|work trip} to Wellington next week.

zh: 她从三月开始休育儿假。
en: She's going on {parental leave|maternity leave} from March.

zh: 新员工有九十天的试用期。
en: New staff have a ninety-day {trial period|probation period|probationary period}.

zh: 离职前，人事部会跟你做一次离职面谈。
en: HR will do an {exit interview} with you before you leave.

zh: 他收到了奥克兰一家公司的录用通知。
en: He got a {job offer} from a company in Auckland.

zh: 申请时请附上简历和求职信。
en: Please attach your CV and a {cover letter|covering letter} with your application.

zh: 我们在开放式办公室里工作，所以挺吵的。
en: We work in an {open-plan office|open plan office}, so it's quite noisy.

zh: 我们会在三个工作日内回复您。
en: We'll get back to you within three {working days|business days}.

zh: 这个决定是总部做的。
en: The decision was made at {head office|headquarters}.

zh: 请假要先经过你的直属经理批准。
en: Your leave has to be approved by your {line manager|direct manager} first.

zh: 你现在的职位名称是什么？
en: What's your current {job title}?

zh: 这个项目的截止日期很紧。
en: We're working to a {tight deadline} on this project.

zh: 我们需要先跟主要的利益相关方谈一谈。
en: We need to talk to the {key stakeholders|main stakeholders} first.

zh: 你能在站会上给大家一个进度更新吗？
en: Can you give us a {status update|progress update} at stand-up?

zh: 我订了三楼的会议室。
en: I've booked the {meeting room|conference room} on the third floor.

zh: 我还不确定自己的职业发展道路。
en: I'm still not sure about my {career path}.

zh: 我周五要休一天假。
en: I'm taking a {day off} on Friday.

zh: 我换工作是为了更好的工作与生活平衡。
en: I changed jobs for a better {work-life balance|work life balance}.

zh: 新系统不容易上手，学习曲线很陡。
en: The new system isn't easy to pick up. It has a steep {learning curve}.
